disclaimer: Not financial advice. This is an educational evaluation of a small transformer against naive baselines on past prices. It is not a forecast you should trade on, and it is not a claim about future returns.

narratives.stocks: Equity and index results use the same return baseline. A single recent holdout is not evidence of a tradable edge. 2 of 4 series had a lower RMSE than persistence, but the median ratio was 0.999 and median directional accuracy was 52.3%. The sign of the training-set mean return matched the holdout more often (median 54.1%) than the model did.
narratives.fx: FX reference rates are close to a random walk. The typical series did not beat a no-change forecast (median RMSE 1.000 times persistence, 19 of 41 series lower). Median directional accuracy was 51.0%.
narratives.crypto: Daily crypto closes are volatile, and a useful forecast still has to beat predicting that tomorrow's return is zero. The typical series did not beat a no-change forecast (median RMSE 1.002 times persistence, 12 of 50 series lower). Median directional accuracy was 50.8%.
narratives.commodities: Commodity results use the same return baseline. Front-month futures include contract rolls, so they are not a pure spot series. 5 of 9 series had a lower RMSE than persistence, but the median ratio was 1.000 and median directional accuracy was 50.8%. The sign of the training-set mean return matched the holdout more often (median 52.2%) than the model did.
